items.title: 鴻海、輝達合作DGX SuperPOD應用 AI訓練效能提升2.48倍
items.title_en: Foxconn and NVIDIA Collaborate on DGX SuperPOD to Boost AI Training Performance by 2.48×
paras: 鴻海(2317-TW)與輝達(NVIDIA)(NVDA-US)合作，導入NVIDIA DGX SuperPOD及DGX GB200系統，加速自研大型語言模型FoxBrain訓練，1200億參數模型的訓練速度較過去採用H100的方案提升2.48倍，在12天內處理1兆Tokens，進一步強化AI模型訓練能力，推動AI技術導入全球製造據點。
透過NVIDIA DGX SuperPOD搭配NVIDIA Blackwell架構及NVLink交換器，可整合多顆GPU的運算資源，加速大型AI模型訓練。鴻海以此為基礎訓練FoxBrain，並進一步結合工業資料與多模態推理能力，發展視覺語言模型，將AI應用延伸至製造、電動車及智慧城市等領域。
在模型訓練效能方面，鴻海採用DGX SuperPOD訓練1200億參數模型，速度較先前以H100為基礎的解決方案提升2.48倍；此外，透過DGX SuperPOD在12天內處理1兆個Tokens，支援FoxBrain模型持續訓練及多模態能力發展。
除了提升模型訓練效能，鴻海也將AI導入生產管理流程，透過自動化生產排程系統(APS)減少工廠排程工時25%，降低生產規劃的人力負擔。在射出成型製程方面，運用AI最佳化製程設定參數，將製程切換相關工程工作量降低50%，提升生產流程效率。
在產線品質管理方面，鴻海運用AI分析SMT產線問題，已針對超過20項主要缺陷根因進行改善，異常改善率逾90%。透過AI模型分析及即時決策能力，將AI應用延伸至製造現場，協助辨識產線異常原因，並提升問題處理效率。
鴻海也運用NVIDIA Mission Control管理AI運算資源，支援全球超過200個廠區的AI工作負載調度，並結合NVIDIA Run及NIM微服務，提升AI模型部署彈性。此外，鴻海採用NVIDIA RTX PRO伺服器，支援工廠數位孿生模擬及AI代理工作流程，透過NVIDIA Omniverse與Isaac模擬機器人及生產環境，協助產線驗證與複製，加速AI技術導入全球製造據點。
鴻海也將持續與輝達合作，推動AI在智慧製造、智慧電動車及智慧城市等領域的應用，並透過AI Token生態系與開放式代理框架，協助企業發展客製化AI代理，擴大AI技術在產業的應用。
paras_en: Foxconn (2317‑TW) and NVIDIA (NVDA‑US) have partnered to deploy NVIDIA DGX SuperPOD and DGX GB200 systems, accelerating the training of their in‑house large‑language model FoxBrain. The 120‑billion‑parameter model now trains 2.48 times faster than the previous H100‑based solution, processing 1 trillion tokens in 12 days and further strengthening AI model‑training capabilities for rollout across global manufacturing sites.

Using the NVIDIA DGX SuperPOD together with the Blackwell architecture and NVLink switches, multiple GPUs can be pooled to speed up large‑AI model training. Foxconn leverages this platform to train FoxBrain and, by integrating industrial data and multimodal reasoning, develop a visual‑language model that extends AI applications to manufacturing, electric vehicles and smart‑city domains.

In terms of training efficiency, Foxconn’s DGX SuperPOD runs the 120‑billion‑parameter model 2.48× faster than its earlier H100‑based setup; the system also processes 1 trillion tokens within 12 days, supporting continuous FoxBrain training and the development of multimodal capabilities.

Beyond faster model training, Foxconn is embedding AI into production management. An automated production scheduling (APS) system cuts factory scheduling labor by 25%, reducing the human burden of production planning. In injection‑molding processes, AI‑optimized settings halve the engineering effort required for process change, boosting overall workflow efficiency.

For line‑quality control, Foxconn uses AI to analyze SMT line issues, improving the root causes of more than 20 major defects with an abnormal‑improvement rate exceeding 90%. Real‑time AI model analysis and decision‑making extend AI use to the shop floor, helping identify line anomalies and accelerate problem‑resolution speed.

Foxconn also employs NVIDIA Mission Control to manage AI compute resources, supporting AI workload scheduling across more than 200 global sites. Combined with NVIDIA Run and NIM micro‑services, this enhances flexibility in AI model deployment. Additionally, NVIDIA RTX PRO servers enable digital‑twin simulations and AI‑agent workflows, while NVIDIA Omniverse and Isaac simulate robots and production environments to validate and replicate lines, speeding AI adoption worldwide.

Foxconn will continue its collaboration with NVIDIA to advance AI in smart manufacturing, electric vehicles and smart cities. Through an AI token ecosystem and open‑agent framework, the company aims to help enterprises build customized AI agents, expanding AI technology’s reach across industries.

items.title: 主動式ETF規模逼近兆元！績效驗收差距拉開 00400A黑馬突圍
items.title_en: Active ETFs Near One Trillion! Performance Gap Widens, 00400A Dark Horse Breaks Through
paras: 主動式 ETF 熱潮持續延燒，截至 9 月底，全市場已有 40 檔，總規模達 9,886 億元、逼近兆元大關，受益人數突破 425 萬人，躍居 ETF 市場新寵。然而，隨著台股拉回與 AI 進入獲利驗證期，主動選股能力正面臨考驗，最新績效評比顯示市場明顯分化，近三個月報酬首尾差距逾 17 個百分點。在此波淘金熱中，主動國泰動能高息(00400A-TW)憑藉精準的進場時點與權重配置逆勢突圍，以 7.91% 報酬率躍居績效冠軍。
今年AI題材雖帶動台股攻高，但隨投資人開始檢視實質效益，投資邏輯已從題材追逐轉向獲利驗證，但即使同處AI供應鏈，企業在訂單品質與毛利率上的差異也讓股價走勢大不同，基金團隊的選股與調整功力更形重要。

根據投信投顧公會最新基金績效評比資料顯示，戰況已明顯分化，9月共有20檔台股主動式ETF列入績效評比；若從近三個月表現來看，僅9檔繳出正報酬，另有11檔落入負值，首尾差距達17.61個百分點，平均報酬率僅0.60%。在逾半數基金收黑之際，主動國泰動能高息(00400A-TW)則以7.91%的報酬率高居第一，不僅領先同類型基金平均7.31個百分點，更在盤勢起伏中逆勢突圍，成為這波績效競賽竄出的黑馬。
值得注意的是，檢視績效前段班主動式ETF的最新持股，部分熱門標的不乏重疊，為何最終繳出的成績仍有落差，也成為市場討論焦點。對此，券商表示，前十大持股只能呈現特定時間點的投資組合面貌，無法完整反映各基金的進場成本、持有期間、配置比重及調整過程，因此持股名單相似，不見得會帶來相同結果。
券商分析，真正拉開績效差距的關鍵，在於能否及早發掘成長企業、掌握進場時點及配置比重，並在股價明顯偏離企業價值時適度調整部位。即使是同一檔股票，早期布局後隨股價上漲而成為主要持股，與漲多後才提高配置，對基金績效的貢獻也可能截然不同。

00400A基金經理人梁恩溢表示，近期股市波動反映投資人重新評估企業前景，但AI需求並未消失，而是由題材驅動進入「獲利驗證」階段，選股除了看企業是否搭上AI列車，更要觀察技術門檻、競爭優勢與訂單品質是否順利轉化為實質營收。AI產業鏈橫跨半導體、伺服器、散熱及電力基礎建設等領域，各板塊受惠時程與成長速度不一，在類股快速輪動、個股表現分歧之際，投資組合必須隨產業脈動適時調整，並持續追蹤市場評價，聚焦獲利成長具有支撐且評價合理的優質企業。
展望後市，梁恩溢表示，企業財報、法說會及營運展望將持續牽動資金布局，大盤回檔不代表成長契機消失，反而可能進一步拉開企業間的表現差距。當資金重新回歸基本面，與其追逐短線熱門題材，更應聚焦具備獲利支撐、產業競爭力及合理評價的企業，透過主動布局掌握台股成長契機，同時兼顧風險控管。

paras_en: The active‑ETF boom continues to blaze. By the end of September, the market hosts 40 funds with a total net asset value of NT$9.886 billion, approaching the one‑trillion‑NT$ mark, and has attracted over 4.25 million investors, becoming the new darling of the ETF market. Yet, as the Taiwan stock index pulls back and AI moves into a profit‑validation phase, active stock‑picking skill is being tested. The latest performance rankings show a clear market split, with a more than 17‑percentage‑point gap in three‑month returns. In this gold‑rush, Cathay‑Active Momentum High‑Yield (00400A‑TW) leveraged precise entry timing and weight allocation to surge ahead, posting a 7.91% return to claim the performance crown.

This year AI themes have driven the Taiwan market higher, but as investors begin to scrutinise real benefits, investment logic has shifted from chasing themes to validating profits. Even within the AI supply chain, differences in order quality and margins cause stock price trajectories to diverge sharply, making the fund team’s stock‑selection and adjustment ability even more critical.

According to the latest fund performance data from the Investment Trust and Advisory Association, the battle lines are clearly drawn. In September, 20 Taiwan‑stock active ETFs were evaluated; over the past three months only nine delivered positive returns while eleven posted negatives, a spread of 17.61 percentage points and an average return of just 0.60%. While more than half of the funds turned red, Cathay‑Active Momentum High‑Yield (00400A‑TW) topped the list with a 7.91% return, out‑performing its peers by 7.31 percentage points and breaking out against market volatility as the dark horse of this performance contest.

It is noteworthy that a look at the latest holdings of the top‑performing active ETFs shows considerable overlap among popular stocks. Why the final results still differ has become a market talking point. Brokers explain that the top‑ten holdings only reflect a snapshot of the portfolio at a specific time and cannot fully capture each fund’s entry cost, holding period, allocation weight and adjustment process; thus similar holdings do not necessarily yield identical outcomes.

Broker analysis points to the real driver of performance gaps: the ability to spot growth companies early, time entries correctly, and size allocations appropriately, then adjust positions when prices stray far from intrinsic value. Even with the same stock, early positioning that rides a price rise can become a core holding, whereas increasing weight only after a big jump contributes very differently to fund performance.

Fund manager Liang En‑yi of the 00400A fund said recent market swings reflect investors re‑evaluating corporate outlooks, but AI demand has not vanished—it has moved from a theme‑driven surge to a “profit‑validation” stage. Stock selection now looks beyond whether a company is on the AI train to assess technical barriers, competitive advantages and whether order quality translates into real revenue. The AI value chain spans semiconductors, servers, cooling and power infrastructure, with each segment benefitting at different times and speeds. Amid rapid sector rotation and divergent stock performance, portfolios must adjust with industry rhythms, continuously track market valuations and focus on high‑quality firms with profit growth, solid fundamentals and reasonable pricing.

Looking ahead, Liang En‑yi said corporate earnings reports, briefings and outlooks will keep steering capital allocation. A market pull‑back does not mean growth opportunities disappear; it may even widen performance gaps between companies. When capital returns to fundamentals, investors should focus less on short‑term hot themes and more on firms with profit support, competitive industry positions and fair valuations, using active positioning to capture Taiwan‑stock growth opportunities while managing risk.

items.title: 馬斯克稱SpaceX敲定400億美元債務協議！用於採購輝達AI晶片
items.title_en: Musk Says SpaceX Secured $40 Billion Debt Deal for Nvidia AI Chip Purchases
paras: 馬斯克表示，SpaceX(SPCX-US) 已完成一筆規模達400億美元的債務融資交易，用於支付推動其人工智慧（AI）發展計畫所需的晶片費用。
根據《彭博》報導，馬斯克在社群平台X發文討論這項表外融資安排時指出，SpaceX已敲定這筆債務融資，用於採購輝達(NVDA-US) 的圖形處理器（GPU）。
他表示，SpaceX之所以能取得這筆融資，歸功於公司的投資級信用評等，以及星鏈（Starlink）衛星業務和火箭發射業務帶來的營收。
然而，知情人士表示，截至週日（25日），相關各方仍在協商最終定價，這筆交易尚未完成。
馬斯克提及SpaceX多元化的業務布局，藉此將公司與所謂的「新型雲端業者」（neocloud）做區分。這類業者主要向科技公司提供高階運算能力。過去兩週，由於這些公司的借貸規模龐大，且市場對其未來需求前景存疑，因此受到密切關注。
馬斯克在貼文中表示：「過去幾週以來，債務市場幾乎已全面切斷對那些無法從AI資料中心以外的業務取得可觀營收的企業提供資金。」
他指出：「200多家新型雲端業者將面臨如小魚般大量死亡的淘汰潮與整併。最終能存活下來的寥寥無幾。」
他隨後表示，SpaceX不會收購任何新型雲端業者，並稱這麼做「毫無意義」。
隨著市場對AI基礎設施投資熱潮的疑慮升高，SpaceX也未能完全置身事外。根據《彭博》上週五（23日）報導，近期新型雲端業者市場動盪，波及SpaceX規模400億美元的晶片融資計畫，相關各方仍在協商這項表外融資架構的最終定價。
知情人士透露，這項融資安排由高盛集團(GS-US) 等銀行主導，並與由阿波羅全球管理（Apollo Global Management）領軍的投資人洽談。獲阿波羅支持的Atlas SP預計將負責管理相關融資實體。據悉，太平洋投資管理公司（PIMCO）也曾考慮參與投資。
這筆債務預計將透過144A私募方式發行。透過這項最新的融資架構，SpaceX將可避免重演馬斯克旗下AI新創公司xAI去年融資時的情況。當時，一家融資實體試圖透過與Valor Equity Partners簽訂售後租回協議，籌集最高200億美元的表外債務。
然而，根據SpaceX最新財報，該交易最終被認定為「無效的售後租回安排」，導致SpaceX仍須將約130億美元債務列入帳目。
這筆債務融資計畫是在SpaceX第三季業績強勁、旗下AI部門首度實現獲利後提出的。SpaceX正逐漸透過旗下位於孟菲斯的資料中心，向外部AI實驗室及超大規模雲端服務商出售運算能力，藉此帶動營收成長。
在SpaceX的財報電話會議上，財務長Bret Johnsen透露，公司正與貸款機構洽談進一步借款事宜。
他表示：「我們非常有信心，能夠以審慎、有節制的方式推動這項計畫，並在整個過程中持續維持投資級信用評等。」

paras_en: Musk said SpaceX (SPCX-US) has completed a $40 billion debt financing transaction to cover the chip costs needed for its artificial intelligence (AI) development program.

According to Bloomberg, Musk posted on X about this off‑balance‑sheet financing arrangement, noting that SpaceX has locked in the debt financing to purchase graphics processing units (GPUs) from Nvidia (NVDA-US).
He said SpaceX was able to obtain the financing thanks to the company’s investment‑grade credit rating and the revenue generated by its Starlink satellite business and rocket launch operations.
However, sources familiar with the matter said that as of Sunday (the 25th), the parties were still negotiating the final pricing and the deal had not yet been completed.

Musk highlighted SpaceX’s diversified business layout to distinguish the company from so‑called “neocloud” providers, which mainly offer high‑performance computing power to tech firms. Over the past two weeks these providers have been under close scrutiny due to their large borrowing needs and uncertain future demand outlooks.
In his post, Musk wrote: “In recent weeks the debt market has virtually cut off funding to companies that cannot generate substantial revenue from businesses beyond AI data centers.”
He added: “More than 200 neocloud providers will face a wave of eliminations and consolidations akin to a school of small fish dying off. Only a few will survive.”
He later said SpaceX will not acquire any neocloud providers, calling such a move “meaningless.”

As doubts grow about the AI infrastructure investment boom, SpaceX is not entirely insulated. Bloomberg reported last Friday (the 23rd) that turbulence in the neocloud market has affected SpaceX’s $40 billion chip financing plan, with parties still negotiating the final pricing of the off‑balance‑sheet structure.

Sources said the financing arrangement is being led by banks such as Goldman Sachs (GS‑US) and is being discussed with investors led by Apollo Global Management. An Atlas SP backed by Apollo is expected to manage the financing entity, and Pacific Investment Management Company (PIMCO) has also been reported to consider participation.

The debt is expected to be issued privately under Rule 144A. Through this new financing structure, SpaceX can avoid repeating the situation that occurred last year when Musk’s AI startup xAI tried to raise up to $20 billion of off‑balance‑sheet debt via a sale‑and‑leaseback agreement with Valor Equity Partners.
However, SpaceX’s latest financial report said that the transaction was ultimately deemed an “invalid sale‑and‑leaseback arrangement,” leaving about $13 billion of debt still on the books.

The financing plan was proposed after SpaceX posted strong third‑quarter results and its AI division posted its first profit. SpaceX is increasingly selling compute capacity from its Memphis data center to external AI labs and hyperscale cloud providers to drive revenue growth.
During the earnings call, CFO Bret Johnsen disclosed that the company is in talks with lenders about additional borrowing.
He said, “We are very confident we can advance this plan in a prudent, disciplined manner while maintaining our investment‑grade credit rating throughout.”

items.title: AI基建商機、台電強韌電網計畫雙重助攻 重電四雄營運可期
items.title_en: AI Infrastructure Opportunities and Taipower’s Resilient Grid Plan Provide Dual Boost, Heavy‑Electricity Four Giants Poised for Strong Operations
paras: 重電四雄華城(1519-TW)、亞力(1514-TW)、士電(1503-TW)以及中興電(1513-TW)受惠AI帶動基礎建設需求，加上台電強韌電網計劃，下半年營運可期，且訂單能見度直指2029至2031年。
華城上半年因外銷美國的交貨小部分延遲，使得營收稍微下滑，不過下半年起陸續追上，第三季營收近60億元，季對季、年對年都成長，預期下半年營運將優於上半年。此外，今年持續受惠AIDC、美國基礎建設、台電強韌電網計畫與科技業擴廠，其中，AIDC累計在手訂單達220億元，整體訂單能見度看至2029年。
華城9月營收20.29億元，月增5.58%，年增7.19%；第三季營收59.95億元，季增9.88%，年增2.79%；累計今年前三季營收163.26億元，年減0.73%。
亞力在手訂單約130億元，半導體占比35%，台電占30%，軌道交通占15至20%，AIDC占5至10%。亞力指出，公司業務重心已從台電轉至半導體產業。同時，公司積極布局海外，半導體客戶的美國第三期訂單於本季接單、明年出貨，日本也於本季接單，預計今年底至明年第一季出貨。
亞力9月營收9.81億元，月增26.8%，年增10.4%；第三季營收26.5億元，季減6%，年減5.76%；累計今年前三季營收80.25億元，年增8.24%。
士電同樣受惠台電強讓電網計畫、AIDC及科技業建廠動能帶動，目前在手訂單超過600億元，將集中於2027至2028年出貨，並已開始承接2029至2030年訂單。士電指出，科技產業營收占國內整體營收近25%，法人預期，今年相關業績可望年增2成。
士電9月營收31.39億元，月增10.29%，年增8.24%；第三季營收89.56億元，季減6.35%，年增7.4%；累計今年前三季營收300.79億元，年增9.4%。
中興電在手訂單則達431億元，部分訂單能見看至2030億元。中興電因其345kV GIS設備為國內唯一取得認證的廠商，台電取單上相對有優勢，也同樣受惠半導體產業擴廠，今年營運有望逐季升溫。
中興電9月營收24.17億元，月減3.41%，年增11.27%；第三季營收73.29億元，季減2.71%，年增7.92%；累計今年前三季營收213.53億元，年增4.97%。
paras_en: The four heavy‑electricity leaders—Huacheng (1519‑TW), A‑Li (1514‑TW), Shidian (1503‑TW) and Zhongxing Electric (1513‑TW)—are benefiting from AI‑driven infrastructure demand and Taipower’s resilient grid program, making the second half of the year promising for operations, with order visibility extending to 2029‑2031.

Huacheng’s first‑half revenue slipped slightly due to a minor delivery delay to the United States, but it is catching up in the second half. Third‑quarter revenue approached NT$6 billion, showing growth both quarter‑over‑quarter and year‑over‑year, and the company expects the second half to outperform the first. This year it continues to benefit from AIDC, U.S. infrastructure projects, Taipower’s resilient grid plan and tech‑sector capacity expansions; AIDC orders on hand total NT$22 billion, giving the company order visibility through 2029.

Huacheng posted NT$2.029 billion revenue in September, up 5.58% month‑over‑month and 7.19% year‑over‑year; third‑quarter revenue was NT$5.995 billion, up 9.88% sequentially and 2.79% annually; cumulative revenue for the first three quarters was NT$16.326 billion, down 0.73% year‑over‑year.

A‑Li has about NT$13 billion of orders on hand, with 35% from semiconductors, 30% from Taipower, 15‑20% from rail transit and 5‑10% from AIDC. The company says its business focus has shifted from Taipower to the semiconductor sector. It is also actively expanding overseas: a third‑phase U.S. semiconductor order was received this quarter for delivery next year, and a Japanese order was taken this quarter, expected to ship by the end of this year or early next year.

A‑Li recorded NT$981 million revenue in September, up 26.8% month‑over‑month and 10.4% year‑over‑year; third‑quarter revenue was NT$2.65 billion, down 6% sequentially and 5.76% annually; cumulative revenue for the first three quarters was NT$8.025 billion, up 8.24% year‑over‑year.

Shidian likewise benefits from Taipower’s resilient grid plan, AIDC and tech‑industry plant construction, with orders on hand exceeding NT$60 billion, slated mainly for shipments in 2027‑2028 and already taking orders for 2029‑2030. Shidian notes that the tech sector accounts for nearly 25% of its domestic revenue, and analysts expect related earnings to grow about 20% this year.

Shidian posted NT$3.139 billion revenue in September, up 10.29% month‑over‑month and 8.24% year‑over‑year; third‑quarter revenue was NT$8.956 billion, down 6.35% sequentially but up 7.4% annually; cumulative revenue for the first three quarters was NT$30.079 billion, up 9.4% year‑over‑year.

Zhongxing Electric’s order backlog reached NT$43.1 billion, with some orders visible through 2030. Because its 345 kV GIS equipment is the only domestically certified product, Zhongxing enjoys an advantage in winning Taipower contracts and also benefits from semiconductor plant expansions, positioning its operations for quarterly growth this year.

Zhongxing Electric recorded NT$2.417 billion revenue in September, down 3.41% month‑over‑month but up 11.27% year‑over‑year; third‑quarter revenue was NT$7.329 billion, down 2.71% sequentially and up 7.92% annually; cumulative revenue for the first three quarters was NT$21.353 billion, up 4.97% year‑over‑year.

items.title: 穆迪未降評法國國債　為什麼歐元空頭部位仍升至逾6年高位？
items.title_en: Moody's Holds France's Sovereign Rating, Yet Euro Short Positions Rise to Over Six-Year High
paras: 國際信評機構穆迪上周五(23日)宣布維持法國主權信用評等不變，但展望仍為「負面」，讓深陷債務與政治壓力的法國獲得短暫喘息，但評等維持並非無條件，該機構假定法國能通過一份削減赤字的2027年預算，且未來數月融資成本與社會動盪有所緩解，評等仍比標普、惠譽的A+高一檔。
市場原本普遍預期穆迪會跟進降級。Allspring組合經理Rushabh Amin在結果公佈前表示，降級風險已很大程度被計入，後續焦點在評級展望。
穆迪也警告，2027年總統大選後，法國仍須持續大幅整固財政，才能穩住預計將突破GDP 120%的債務負擔。
債市早已先一步重新定價。法國10年期公債殖利率一度觸及5.14%，創2002年7月以來高點，法德公債殖利率差距上周四(22日)擴至178個基點，較上月初的85個基點接近翻倍。投資人要求更高風險補償，反映預算案能否過關的懷疑。
槓桿基金同步押注歐元走弱。根據CFTC數據顯示，截至上周二(20日)，歐元期貨及選擇權合併口徑淨空倉達94138口，為2020年3月以來最高，多倉96070口、空倉190208口，但數據截止早於穆迪評級消息，尚不能判斷空頭回補是否發生。
政治阻力仍是關鍵變數。法國政府擬以縮減與增稅把2027年赤字壓至5%，今年預計5.4%，但在國民議會缺乏多數席次。上周五社保預算收入部分遭否決，主預算案下週繼續審議；法國財政部長則稱5%目標「不可改變」。
分析師指出，負面展望與大額空倉顯示市場仍視法國財政為風險源頭，未降評不代表壓力解除，預算博弈與歐洲央行(ECB)政策預期將繼續牽動歐元與法債。
paras_en: International rating agency Moody's announced on Friday (the 23rd) that it is keeping France's sovereign credit rating unchanged, but the outlook remains "negative," giving the debt‑ and politically‑pressured France a brief reprieve. The unchanged rating is not unconditional; Moody's assumes France can pass a deficit‑cutting 2027 budget and that financing costs and social unrest will ease in the coming months, keeping the rating one notch above S&P and Fitch's A+.

The market had broadly expected Moody's to follow through with a downgrade. Allspring portfolio manager Rushabh Amin said before the announcement that downgrade risk had already been largely priced in, and the focus now shifts to the rating outlook.

Moody's also warned that after the 2027 presidential election, France will still need to undertake a substantial fiscal consolidation to stabilize a debt burden that is projected to exceed 120% of GDP.

The bond market has already re‑priced ahead of the rating decision. France's 10‑year gilt yield briefly hit 5.14%, the highest level since July 2002, and the spread between French and German 10‑year yields widened to 178 basis points on Thursday (the 22nd), nearly doubling the 85‑basis‑point gap at the start of the month. Investors are demanding higher risk premiums, reflecting doubts over whether the budget plan will pass.

Leveraged funds are simultaneously betting on a weaker euro. CFTC data show that as of Tuesday (the 20th), net short positions in euro futures and options combined reached 94,138 contracts—the highest since March 2020—with long positions at 96,070 contracts and shorts at 190,208 contracts. However, the data predate Moody's rating news, so it is unclear whether short covering has begun.

Political resistance remains a key variable. The French government plans to cut spending and raise taxes to bring the 2027 deficit down to 5% of GDP, with a target of 5.4% for this year, but it lacks a parliamentary majority. Parts of the social‑security budget were rejected last Friday, and the main budget will be debated again next week; the finance minister said the 5% goal is "non‑negotiable."

Analysts note that the negative outlook and large short positions indicate the market still sees France's fiscal situation as a risk source. The lack of a downgrade does not mean pressure has eased; the budget battle and ECB policy expectations will continue to influence the euro and French bonds.

items.title: 川普示警對伊朗「到了決策時刻」：談判或「徹底了結此事」？
items.title_en: Trump Warns Iran: “Decision Time” – Negotiate or “Put an End to This Completely”?
paras: 美國總統川普表示，在伊朗及其支持的胡塞武裝對中東地區美國人的威脅日益加劇之際，他已到了「必須做出決定」的時刻，究竟是與德黑蘭達成協議，還是恢復對伊打擊。
根據《彭博》報導，川普接受《福斯新聞》（Fox News）節目Sunday Morning Futures專訪時表示：「我必須做出決定，是徹底了結此事，這其實很容易做到，還是達成協議？就這兩個選項。」他並強調：「我們不玩把戲。」
川普此前曾暗示，美軍可能在11月3日期中選舉結束後恢復對伊朗的空襲，並已向波斯灣方向增派軍力，包括派遣第三個航空母艦打擊群。
不過，週日（25日）稍晚，川普離開白宮時向記者表示：「今天不會發動攻擊。」
美國官員警告，從期中選舉結束到新一屆國會正式就任的這段期間，局勢可能格外危險。目前，透過談判達成協議，被視為最有可能結束這場衝突的途徑。
面對伊朗及其支持的葉門胡塞武裝持續升高威脅，美國正縮減中東部分地區的外交與軍事人員部署。胡塞武裝近期持續攻擊沙烏地阿拉伯首都利雅德的機場，該機場已於週日重新開放商業航班。
美國國務院最初僅證實外交人員從沙烏地阿拉伯撤離，但一名美國官員週五告訴《彭博》，隨著伊朗加強攻擊荷姆茲海峽附近的船隻，美國正在更廣泛的區域調整人員部署。
一名了解德黑蘭決策思維的人士表示，伊朗目前正為美國可能在期中選舉前後發動新一輪轟炸做準備，並準備在中東各地展開報復行動，包括攻擊以色列與阿拉伯聯合大公國。
航運業及海事安全官員指出，與這場衝突初期相比，伊朗如今開始攻擊更多位於荷姆茲海峽內或附近的船隻，造成的損害也更加嚴重。伊朗目前改用導引飛彈，而非攻擊型無人機發動攻擊。
布魯金斯研究所（Brookings Institution）中東專家Aslı Aydıntaşbaş表示：「所有跡象都顯示，戰爭將再度爆發，並伴隨大規模轟炸行動，儘管具體時間仍不確定。」
儘管川普似乎正朝著期中選舉後可能恢復攻擊的方向準備，與美國聯手對伊朗發動戰爭的以色列也有自身的政治考量。
在以色列總理納坦雅胡（Benjamin Netanyahu）面臨一場攸關政治前途的連任選舉僅剩數日之際，美國國防部長赫格塞斯（Pete Hegseth）近日未事先公布行程便短暫訪問以色列，並與納坦雅胡會面。
這場競爭激烈的以色列大選將於週二（27日）舉行，是2023年哈瑪斯攻擊事件引發納坦雅胡在加薩與黎巴嫩展開戰爭以來的首次大選。如果納坦雅胡敗選，其主要競爭對手艾森科特（Gadi Eisenkot）上任後，可能不會像納坦雅胡一樣積極推動重啟對伊朗的戰爭。
（本文不開放合作夥伴轉載）
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump said that as the threat from Iran and its proxy Houthi forces to Americans in the Middle East grows, he has reached a "must‑make‑a‑decision" moment – whether to strike a deal with Tehran or resume attacks on Iran.

In an interview with Fox News’ Sunday Morning Futures, Trump told Bloomberg that he must decide "whether to put an end to this completely, which is actually easy to do, or to reach an agreement – those are the two options," and he stressed, "We’re not playing games."

Trump had previously hinted that U.S. forces might resume air strikes on Iran after the November 3 mid‑term elections, and he has already moved additional forces toward the Persian Gulf, including dispatching a third carrier strike group.
However, later on Sunday the 25th, Trump told reporters as he left the White House, "No attack will be launched today."

U.S. officials warn that the period between the end of the mid‑terms and the swearing‑in of the new Congress could be especially dangerous, and a negotiated settlement is currently seen as the most likely way to end the conflict.

Facing a rising threat from Iran and its Yemen‑based Houthi allies, the United States is scaling back diplomatic and military personnel in parts of the Middle East. The Houthis have recently continued attacks on Riyadh’s King Khalid International Airport, which reopened for commercial flights on Sunday.

The State Department initially only confirmed that diplomatic staff were being withdrawn from Saudi Arabia, but a U.S. official told Bloomberg on Friday that, as Iran steps up attacks on vessels near the Strait of Hormuz, the United States is adjusting personnel deployments more broadly across the region.

A source familiar with Tehran’s decision‑making said Iran is preparing for a new round of U.S. bombing around the mid‑term election period and is ready to launch retaliatory actions across the Middle East, including attacks on Israel and the United Arab Emirates.

Shipping and maritime‑security officials note that, compared with the early days of the conflict, Iran is now targeting more vessels inside or near the Strait of Hormuz and causing more severe damage, using guided missiles rather than attack drones.
Brookings Middle‑East expert Aslı Aydıntaşbaş said, "All signs point to war breaking out again with large‑scale bombing, although the exact timing remains uncertain."
Although Trump appears to be gearing up for a post‑midterm resumption of attacks, Israel – a U.S. partner in any war against Iran – also has its own political calculations.

With Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu facing a re‑election battle that could determine his political future in just a few days, Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth made an unannounced short visit to Israel and met with Netanyahu.

The fiercely contested Israeli election will be held on Tuesday the 27th, the first since the 2023 Hamas attacks that led Netanyahu to wage war in Gaza and Lebanon; if Netanyahu loses, his main rival Gadi Eisenkot, who is less likely to push for a renewed war against Iran, could take office.

items.title: 高盛大砍南韓KOSPI目標價25%！但仍看好逾60%上漲空間
items.title_en: Goldman Sachs Slashes South Korea KOSPI Target by 25% Yet Still Sees Over 60% Upside
paras: 隨著市場對人工智慧（AI）交易的疑慮持續升溫，高盛集團策略師在今年多次上調南韓綜合股價指數（KOSPI）目標價後，如今將目標價大砍25%。
根據《彭博》報導，以 Timothy Moe 為首的分析師將 KOSPI 未來12個月目標價從12,000點下調至9,000點，理由是該指數自6月高點重挫逾35%後，團隊採用了更保守的估值假設。
不過，策略師認為，這波拋售已使韓股嚴重遭到低估，而最新目標價仍意味著較目前水準有逾60%的上漲空間。
高盛分析師最近一次上調 KOSPI 目標價是在6月，此後即使全球 AI 概念股自當月稍晚開始遭遇拋售、拖累 KOSPI 成分股走跌，高盛仍一直維持12,000點的目標價。
南韓股市今年成為AI交易的重要風向球，三星電子（Samsung Electronics）與SK海力士（SK Hynix）等半導體巨頭的股價表現，更使KOSPI與AI投資情緒緊密連動。
然而，市場日益擔憂AI產業龐大的基礎設施支出能否帶來足夠回報，加上融資成本上升，相關疑慮持續衝擊科技股，並進一步擴大至南韓整體股市。
高盛策略師在週日（25日）的報告中寫道：「市場對基本面的定價過於悲觀。」
他們表示，下調目標價是為了納入市場可能如何評價企業基本面的更保守假設，但仍認為以目前水準來看，韓股提供了具吸引力的風險報酬比。
根據彭博彙整的數據，南韓股市已從今年表現最強勁的主要市場之一，轉變為全球估值最低的市場之一，其估值約僅為印尼股市的一半。
KOSPI 的未來12個月預估本益比已降至約4倍，這樣的估值水準是18個市場中自2006年以來首見；而 KOSPI 在2026年初的市值曾突破1兆美元。
高盛策略師估計，目前半導體類股的估值，相當於市場預期該產業2027年獲利將衰退65%，團隊認為這種情境過於悲觀。
此外，占 KOSPI 約一半權重的非記憶體類股，目前預估本益比為7.6倍。
儘管此次下修大盤目標價，高盛仍持續看好電力、工業、企業治理相關股票，以及受惠於國內再通膨與韓流文化發展的企業。

paras_en: As concerns over artificial intelligence (AI) trading continue to rise, Goldman Sachs strategists, who have raised the South Korean composite stock index (KOSPI) target several times this year, are now cutting the target by 25%.

According to Bloomberg, analysts led by Timothy Moe lowered the KOSPI 12‑month target from 12,000 points to 9,000 points, citing that the index has fallen more than 35% from its June peak and the team is using more conservative valuation assumptions.
However, the strategists argue that this wave of selling has left Korean equities severely undervalued, and the new target still implies more than a 60% upside from current levels.

Goldman’s analysts last raised the KOSPI target in June; despite global AI‑related stocks beginning to sell off later that month and dragging down KOSPI components, Goldman kept the 12,000‑point target unchanged.

South Korea’s market has become a key barometer for AI trading this year, with semiconductor giants such as Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix closely tying KOSPI performance to AI investment sentiment.

Yet the market is increasingly worried whether the massive infrastructure spending in the AI sector can generate sufficient returns, and rising financing costs are further weighing on tech stocks and spilling over into the broader Korean market.
Goldman strategists wrote in a Sunday (the 25th) report: “The market’s pricing of fundamentals is overly pessimistic.”

They said the target cut reflects more conservative assumptions about how the market may value corporate fundamentals, but they still believe Korean equities offer an attractive risk‑reward profile at current levels.

Bloomberg‑compiled data shows the South Korean market has shifted from being one of the strongest performers this year to one of the world’s lowest‑valued markets, with valuations roughly half of Indonesia’s market.
The KOSPI’s 12‑month forward price‑to‑earnings ratio has fallen to about 4×, a level not seen in any of 18 markets since 2006; the index’s market cap briefly topped $1 trillion in early 2026.
Goldman estimates that current semiconductor valuations imply the market expects the sector’s 2027 earnings to decline by 65%, a scenario the team deems overly gloomy.
In addition, non‑memory chips, which make up roughly half of the KOSPI’s weight, are now estimated at a forward P/E of 7.6×.

Despite the downgrade to the broad‑market target, Goldman remains bullish on stocks related to power, industrials, corporate governance and companies benefiting from domestic re‑inflation and the Korean Wave culture.

items.title: 韓股便宜到破紀錄 預估本益比僅4.2倍、兆美元市場首見
items.title_en: South Korean Stocks Hit Record Lows, Forecast P/E Only 4.2×, First Trillion‑Dollar Market to Do So
paras: 隨著人工智慧（AI）熱潮降溫、資金撤離科技股，南韓綜合指數(KOSPI) 未來12個月預估本益比降至4.2倍。根據彭博可追溯至2006年的數據，在今年初市值超過1兆美元的18個市場中，韓國成為首個基準指數預估本益比跌破5倍的市場。
這項紀錄凸顯韓股折價程度之深。KOSPI先前曾是今年科技股漲勢的代表性指數之一，受惠於AI相關需求，半導體類股大幅走高。然而，隨著AI熱潮降溫，原本支撐行情的投資邏輯迅速逆轉，亞洲部分主要股指遭到拋售，韓股首當其衝，資金加速撤出。
在彭博涵蓋近20年的資料中，今年初市值超過1兆美元的18個市場，過去未曾有任何基準指數的預估本益比跌破5倍。如今KOSPI打破這項紀錄，顯示韓股估值已降至這批大型市場過去未曾觸及的水準。不過，這項統計範圍並不包括雅加達綜合指數。
若與印尼股市比較，韓股目前的本益比僅略高於雅加達綜合指數的一半。印尼股市正因MSCI可能將該國連降兩級而大幅下挫，韓股估值卻仍明顯低於印尼，進一步凸顯市場對韓國股票給予的低評價。
與低迷估值形成對照的是，韓國今年出口額正朝1兆美元大關邁進，SK海力士與三星電子的晶片需求依然旺盛。然而，這些基本面表現尚未扭轉投資人的悲觀情緒，市場仍不願為分享科技巨頭的獲利支付更高價格。
韓股長期以來相較全球同業存在估值折價，並非新現象。這次值得關注之處，在於韓國經濟強勁成長期間，折價不僅未見收斂，反而持續擴大，企業需求與股市評價之間的落差更加鮮明。
彭博時評作者Garfield Reynolds指出，這種情況意味著，一旦市場情緒轉向、局勢塵埃落定，韓股可能迎來一段持續領先其他市場的時期。極度壓縮的估值，因而也可能為後續反彈留下可觀空間。
不過，低估值同時是一把雙面刃。對投資人而言，真正的難題不只是韓股有多便宜，而是估值回升的轉捩點何時出現，以及在此之前，KOSPI是否還會進一步下跌，讓目前已創紀錄的本益比繼續下探。
這兩個問題目前都沒有明確答案。即使韓股已成為這批兆美元級市場中首個預估本益比跌破5倍的市場，極低估值仍未自動轉化為買進訊號。潛在反彈空間與進一步下跌的可能性並存，進場時機仍是投資人面臨的核心考驗。
paras_en: As the AI hype cools and funds flee tech stocks, the South Korean composite index (KOSPI) is projected to see its price‑earnings ratio fall to 4.2 times over the next 12 months. Bloomberg data dating back to 2006 shows that among the 18 markets with market capitalisations exceeding $1 trillion at the start of this year, Korea is the first where the benchmark index’s forward P/E is expected to dip below 5×.

This record highlights how deeply discounted Korean equities have become. The KOSPI was earlier one of the flagship indices benefitting from the AI‑driven tech rally, with semiconductor stocks soaring. Yet as AI enthusiasm waned, the investment thesis that had underpinned the rally reversed sharply, prompting sell‑offs across many Asian benchmarks and hitting Korean stocks hardest as capital fled.

In Bloomberg’s nearly 20‑year dataset, none of the 18 trillion‑dollar markets at the start of the year had ever seen a benchmark index’s forward P/E fall below 5×. The KOSPI now breaks that record, showing Korean valuations have slipped to levels unseen in these large markets. The statistic, however, excludes the Jakarta Composite Index.

Compared with Indonesia’s market, Korea’s current P/E is only a little more than half of the Jakarta Composite’s. Indonesia’s market has slumped sharply amid speculation that MSCI may downgrade the country by two tiers, yet Korean valuations remain markedly lower, underscoring the market’s harsh rating of Korean stocks.

Contrasting the low valuations, South Korea’s exports are marching toward the $1 trillion mark this year, and chip demand for SK Hynix and Samsung Electronics stays robust. Still, these fundamentals have not lifted investors’ gloom, and the market remains unwilling to pay higher prices for the profits of its tech giants.

Korean stocks have long traded at a discount to global peers, a pattern that is not new. What is noteworthy now is that during a period of strong economic growth, the discount has not narrowed but widened, making the gap between corporate demand and market valuation even more pronounced.

Bloomberg Opinion columnist Garfield Reynolds notes that this situation means that once sentiment swings back and the dust settles, Korean equities could enjoy a sustained period of outperformance relative to other markets. The severely compressed valuations therefore may leave ample room for a subsequent rebound.

However, low valuations are a double‑edged sword. For investors, the real challenge is not just how cheap Korean stocks are, but when the turning point for valuation recovery will arrive, and whether the KOSPI will fall further before that, pushing the record‑low P/E even lower.

Both questions remain unanswered. Even though Korean stocks are the first among this tranche of trillion‑dollar markets to see a forward P/E dip below 5×, the ultra‑low valuation does not automatically become a buy signal. Potential upside coexists with the risk of further declines, making timing the entry the core test for investors.

items.title: 鴻海、輝達合作DGX SuperPOD應用 AI訓練效能提升2.48倍
items.title_en: Foxconn and NVIDIA Collaborate on DGX SuperPOD to Boost AI Training Performance by 2.48×
paras: 鴻海(2317-TW)與輝達(NVIDIA)(NVDA-US)合作，導入NVIDIA DGX SuperPOD及DGX GB200系統，加速自研大型語言模型FoxBrain訓練，1200億參數模型的訓練速度較過去採用H100的方案提升2.48倍，在12天內處理1兆Tokens，進一步強化AI模型訓練能力，推動AI技術導入全球製造據點。
透過NVIDIA DGX SuperPOD搭配NVIDIA Blackwell架構及NVLink交換器，可整合多顆GPU的運算資源，加速大型AI模型訓練。鴻海以此為基礎訓練FoxBrain，並進一步結合工業資料與多模態推理能力，發展視覺語言模型，將AI應用延伸至製造、電動車及智慧城市等領域。
在模型訓練效能方面，鴻海採用DGX SuperPOD訓練1200億參數模型，速度較先前以H100為基礎的解決方案提升2.48倍；此外，透過DGX SuperPOD在12天內處理1兆個Tokens，支援FoxBrain模型持續訓練及多模態能力發展。
除了提升模型訓練效能，鴻海也將AI導入生產管理流程，透過自動化生產排程系統(APS)減少工廠排程工時25%，降低生產規劃的人力負擔。在射出成型製程方面，運用AI最佳化製程設定參數，將製程切換相關工程工作量降低50%，提升生產流程效率。
在產線品質管理方面，鴻海運用AI分析SMT產線問題，已針對超過20項主要缺陷根因進行改善，異常改善率逾90%。透過AI模型分析及即時決策能力，將AI應用延伸至製造現場，協助辨識產線異常原因，並提升問題處理效率。
鴻海也運用NVIDIA Mission Control管理AI運算資源，支援全球超過200個廠區的AI工作負載調度，並結合NVIDIA Run及NIM微服務，提升AI模型部署彈性。此外，鴻海採用NVIDIA RTX PRO伺服器，支援工廠數位孿生模擬及AI代理工作流程，透過NVIDIA Omniverse與Isaac模擬機器人及生產環境，協助產線驗證與複製，加速AI技術導入全球製造據點。
鴻海也將持續與輝達合作，推動AI在智慧製造、智慧電動車及智慧城市等領域的應用，並透過AI Token生態系與開放式代理框架，協助企業發展客製化AI代理，擴大AI技術在產業的應用。
paras_en: Foxconn (2317‑TW) and NVIDIA (NVDA‑US) have partnered to deploy NVIDIA DGX SuperPOD and DGX GB200 systems, accelerating the training of their in‑house large‑language model FoxBrain. The 120‑billion‑parameter model now trains 2.48 times faster than the previous H100‑based solution, processing 1 trillion tokens in 12 days and further strengthening AI model‑training capabilities for rollout across global manufacturing sites.

Using the NVIDIA DGX SuperPOD together with the Blackwell architecture and NVLink switches, multiple GPUs can be pooled to speed up large‑AI model training. Foxconn leverages this platform to train FoxBrain and, by integrating industrial data and multimodal reasoning, develop a visual‑language model that extends AI applications to manufacturing, electric vehicles and smart‑city domains.

In terms of training efficiency, Foxconn’s DGX SuperPOD runs the 120‑billion‑parameter model 2.48× faster than its earlier H100‑based setup; the system also processes 1 trillion tokens within 12 days, supporting continuous FoxBrain training and the development of multimodal capabilities.

Beyond faster model training, Foxconn is embedding AI into production management. An automated production scheduling (APS) system cuts factory scheduling labor by 25%, reducing the human burden of production planning. In injection‑molding processes, AI‑optimized settings halve the engineering effort required for process change, boosting overall workflow efficiency.

For line‑quality control, Foxconn uses AI to analyze SMT line issues, improving the root causes of more than 20 major defects with an abnormal‑improvement rate exceeding 90%. Real‑time AI model analysis and decision‑making extend AI use to the shop floor, helping identify line anomalies and accelerate problem‑resolution speed.

Foxconn also employs NVIDIA Mission Control to manage AI compute resources, supporting AI workload scheduling across more than 200 global sites. Combined with NVIDIA Run and NIM micro‑services, this enhances flexibility in AI model deployment. Additionally, NVIDIA RTX PRO servers enable digital‑twin simulations and AI‑agent workflows, while NVIDIA Omniverse and Isaac simulate robots and production environments to validate and replicate lines, speeding AI adoption worldwide.

Foxconn will continue its collaboration with NVIDIA to advance AI in smart manufacturing, electric vehicles and smart cities. Through an AI token ecosystem and open‑agent framework, the company aims to help enterprises build customized AI agents, expanding AI technology’s reach across industries.

items.title: 主動式ETF規模逼近兆元！績效驗收差距拉開 00400A黑馬突圍
items.title_en: Active ETFs Near One Trillion! Performance Gap Widens, 00400A Dark Horse Breaks Through
paras: 主動式 ETF 熱潮持續延燒，截至 9 月底，全市場已有 40 檔，總規模達 9,886 億元、逼近兆元大關，受益人數突破 425 萬人，躍居 ETF 市場新寵。然而，隨著台股拉回與 AI 進入獲利驗證期，主動選股能力正面臨考驗，最新績效評比顯示市場明顯分化，近三個月報酬首尾差距逾 17 個百分點。在此波淘金熱中，主動國泰動能高息(00400A-TW)憑藉精準的進場時點與權重配置逆勢突圍，以 7.91% 報酬率躍居績效冠軍。
今年AI題材雖帶動台股攻高，但隨投資人開始檢視實質效益，投資邏輯已從題材追逐轉向獲利驗證，但即使同處AI供應鏈，企業在訂單品質與毛利率上的差異也讓股價走勢大不同，基金團隊的選股與調整功力更形重要。

根據投信投顧公會最新基金績效評比資料顯示，戰況已明顯分化，9月共有20檔台股主動式ETF列入績效評比；若從近三個月表現來看，僅9檔繳出正報酬，另有11檔落入負值，首尾差距達17.61個百分點，平均報酬率僅0.60%。在逾半數基金收黑之際，主動國泰動能高息(00400A-TW)則以7.91%的報酬率高居第一，不僅領先同類型基金平均7.31個百分點，更在盤勢起伏中逆勢突圍，成為這波績效競賽竄出的黑馬。
值得注意的是，檢視績效前段班主動式ETF的最新持股，部分熱門標的不乏重疊，為何最終繳出的成績仍有落差，也成為市場討論焦點。對此，券商表示，前十大持股只能呈現特定時間點的投資組合面貌，無法完整反映各基金的進場成本、持有期間、配置比重及調整過程，因此持股名單相似，不見得會帶來相同結果。
券商分析，真正拉開績效差距的關鍵，在於能否及早發掘成長企業、掌握進場時點及配置比重，並在股價明顯偏離企業價值時適度調整部位。即使是同一檔股票，早期布局後隨股價上漲而成為主要持股，與漲多後才提高配置，對基金績效的貢獻也可能截然不同。

00400A基金經理人梁恩溢表示，近期股市波動反映投資人重新評估企業前景，但AI需求並未消失，而是由題材驅動進入「獲利驗證」階段，選股除了看企業是否搭上AI列車，更要觀察技術門檻、競爭優勢與訂單品質是否順利轉化為實質營收。AI產業鏈橫跨半導體、伺服器、散熱及電力基礎建設等領域，各板塊受惠時程與成長速度不一，在類股快速輪動、個股表現分歧之際，投資組合必須隨產業脈動適時調整，並持續追蹤市場評價，聚焦獲利成長具有支撐且評價合理的優質企業。
展望後市，梁恩溢表示，企業財報、法說會及營運展望將持續牽動資金布局，大盤回檔不代表成長契機消失，反而可能進一步拉開企業間的表現差距。當資金重新回歸基本面，與其追逐短線熱門題材，更應聚焦具備獲利支撐、產業競爭力及合理評價的企業，透過主動布局掌握台股成長契機，同時兼顧風險控管。

paras_en: The active‑ETF boom continues to blaze. By the end of September, the market hosts 40 funds with a total net asset value of NT$9.886 billion, approaching the one‑trillion‑NT$ mark, and has attracted over 4.25 million investors, becoming the new darling of the ETF market. Yet, as the Taiwan stock index pulls back and AI moves into a profit‑validation phase, active stock‑picking skill is being tested. The latest performance rankings show a clear market split, with a more than 17‑percentage‑point gap in three‑month returns. In this gold‑rush, Cathay‑Active Momentum High‑Yield (00400A‑TW) leveraged precise entry timing and weight allocation to surge ahead, posting a 7.91% return to claim the performance crown.

This year AI themes have driven the Taiwan market higher, but as investors begin to scrutinise real benefits, investment logic has shifted from chasing themes to validating profits. Even within the AI supply chain, differences in order quality and margins cause stock price trajectories to diverge sharply, making the fund team’s stock‑selection and adjustment ability even more critical.

According to the latest fund performance data from the Investment Trust and Advisory Association, the battle lines are clearly drawn. In September, 20 Taiwan‑stock active ETFs were evaluated; over the past three months only nine delivered positive returns while eleven posted negatives, a spread of 17.61 percentage points and an average return of just 0.60%. While more than half of the funds turned red, Cathay‑Active Momentum High‑Yield (00400A‑TW) topped the list with a 7.91% return, out‑performing its peers by 7.31 percentage points and breaking out against market volatility as the dark horse of this performance contest.

It is noteworthy that a look at the latest holdings of the top‑performing active ETFs shows considerable overlap among popular stocks. Why the final results still differ has become a market talking point. Brokers explain that the top‑ten holdings only reflect a snapshot of the portfolio at a specific time and cannot fully capture each fund’s entry cost, holding period, allocation weight and adjustment process; thus similar holdings do not necessarily yield identical outcomes.

Broker analysis points to the real driver of performance gaps: the ability to spot growth companies early, time entries correctly, and size allocations appropriately, then adjust positions when prices stray far from intrinsic value. Even with the same stock, early positioning that rides a price rise can become a core holding, whereas increasing weight only after a big jump contributes very differently to fund performance.

Fund manager Liang En‑yi of the 00400A fund said recent market swings reflect investors re‑evaluating corporate outlooks, but AI demand has not vanished—it has moved from a theme‑driven surge to a “profit‑validation” stage. Stock selection now looks beyond whether a company is on the AI train to assess technical barriers, competitive advantages and whether order quality translates into real revenue. The AI value chain spans semiconductors, servers, cooling and power infrastructure, with each segment benefitting at different times and speeds. Amid rapid sector rotation and divergent stock performance, portfolios must adjust with industry rhythms, continuously track market valuations and focus on high‑quality firms with profit growth, solid fundamentals and reasonable pricing.

Looking ahead, Liang En‑yi said corporate earnings reports, briefings and outlooks will keep steering capital allocation. A market pull‑back does not mean growth opportunities disappear; it may even widen performance gaps between companies. When capital returns to fundamentals, investors should focus less on short‑term hot themes and more on firms with profit support, competitive industry positions and fair valuations, using active positioning to capture Taiwan‑stock growth opportunities while managing risk.

items.title: AI基建商機、台電強韌電網計畫雙重助攻 重電四雄營運可期
items.title_en: AI Infrastructure Opportunities and Taipower’s Resilient Grid Plan Provide Dual Boost, Heavy‑Electricity Four Giants Poised for Strong Operations
paras: 重電四雄華城(1519-TW)、亞力(1514-TW)、士電(1503-TW)以及中興電(1513-TW)受惠AI帶動基礎建設需求，加上台電強韌電網計劃，下半年營運可期，且訂單能見度直指2029至2031年。
華城上半年因外銷美國的交貨小部分延遲，使得營收稍微下滑，不過下半年起陸續追上，第三季營收近60億元，季對季、年對年都成長，預期下半年營運將優於上半年。此外，今年持續受惠AIDC、美國基礎建設、台電強韌電網計畫與科技業擴廠，其中，AIDC累計在手訂單達220億元，整體訂單能見度看至2029年。
華城9月營收20.29億元，月增5.58%，年增7.19%；第三季營收59.95億元，季增9.88%，年增2.79%；累計今年前三季營收163.26億元，年減0.73%。
亞力在手訂單約130億元，半導體占比35%，台電占30%，軌道交通占15至20%，AIDC占5至10%。亞力指出，公司業務重心已從台電轉至半導體產業。同時，公司積極布局海外，半導體客戶的美國第三期訂單於本季接單、明年出貨，日本也於本季接單，預計今年底至明年第一季出貨。
亞力9月營收9.81億元，月增26.8%，年增10.4%；第三季營收26.5億元，季減6%，年減5.76%；累計今年前三季營收80.25億元，年增8.24%。
士電同樣受惠台電強讓電網計畫、AIDC及科技業建廠動能帶動，目前在手訂單超過600億元，將集中於2027至2028年出貨，並已開始承接2029至2030年訂單。士電指出，科技產業營收占國內整體營收近25%，法人預期，今年相關業績可望年增2成。
士電9月營收31.39億元，月增10.29%，年增8.24%；第三季營收89.56億元，季減6.35%，年增7.4%；累計今年前三季營收300.79億元，年增9.4%。
中興電在手訂單則達431億元，部分訂單能見看至2030億元。中興電因其345kV GIS設備為國內唯一取得認證的廠商，台電取單上相對有優勢，也同樣受惠半導體產業擴廠，今年營運有望逐季升溫。
中興電9月營收24.17億元，月減3.41%，年增11.27%；第三季營收73.29億元，季減2.71%，年增7.92%；累計今年前三季營收213.53億元，年增4.97%。
paras_en: The four heavy‑electricity leaders—Huacheng (1519‑TW), A‑Li (1514‑TW), Shidian (1503‑TW) and Zhongxing Electric (1513‑TW)—are benefiting from AI‑driven infrastructure demand and Taipower’s resilient grid program, making the second half of the year promising for operations, with order visibility extending to 2029‑2031.

Huacheng’s first‑half revenue slipped slightly due to a minor delivery delay to the United States, but it is catching up in the second half. Third‑quarter revenue approached NT$6 billion, showing growth both quarter‑over‑quarter and year‑over‑year, and the company expects the second half to outperform the first. This year it continues to benefit from AIDC, U.S. infrastructure projects, Taipower’s resilient grid plan and tech‑sector capacity expansions; AIDC orders on hand total NT$22 billion, giving the company order visibility through 2029.

Huacheng posted NT$2.029 billion revenue in September, up 5.58% month‑over‑month and 7.19% year‑over‑year; third‑quarter revenue was NT$5.995 billion, up 9.88% sequentially and 2.79% annually; cumulative revenue for the first three quarters was NT$16.326 billion, down 0.73% year‑over‑year.

A‑Li has about NT$13 billion of orders on hand, with 35% from semiconductors, 30% from Taipower, 15‑20% from rail transit and 5‑10% from AIDC. The company says its business focus has shifted from Taipower to the semiconductor sector. It is also actively expanding overseas: a third‑phase U.S. semiconductor order was received this quarter for delivery next year, and a Japanese order was taken this quarter, expected to ship by the end of this year or early next year.

A‑Li recorded NT$981 million revenue in September, up 26.8% month‑over‑month and 10.4% year‑over‑year; third‑quarter revenue was NT$2.65 billion, down 6% sequentially and 5.76% annually; cumulative revenue for the first three quarters was NT$8.025 billion, up 8.24% year‑over‑year.

Shidian likewise benefits from Taipower’s resilient grid plan, AIDC and tech‑industry plant construction, with orders on hand exceeding NT$60 billion, slated mainly for shipments in 2027‑2028 and already taking orders for 2029‑2030. Shidian notes that the tech sector accounts for nearly 25% of its domestic revenue, and analysts expect related earnings to grow about 20% this year.

Shidian posted NT$3.139 billion revenue in September, up 10.29% month‑over‑month and 8.24% year‑over‑year; third‑quarter revenue was NT$8.956 billion, down 6.35% sequentially but up 7.4% annually; cumulative revenue for the first three quarters was NT$30.079 billion, up 9.4% year‑over‑year.

Zhongxing Electric’s order backlog reached NT$43.1 billion, with some orders visible through 2030. Because its 345 kV GIS equipment is the only domestically certified product, Zhongxing enjoys an advantage in winning Taipower contracts and also benefits from semiconductor plant expansions, positioning its operations for quarterly growth this year.

Zhongxing Electric recorded NT$2.417 billion revenue in September, down 3.41% month‑over‑month but up 11.27% year‑over‑year; third‑quarter revenue was NT$7.329 billion, down 2.71% sequentially and up 7.92% annually; cumulative revenue for the first three quarters was NT$21.353 billion, up 4.97% year‑over‑year.

items.title: 誤會一場 潤泰新：「松濤苑」5樓戶坪價實爲254萬元優於上筆成交
items.title_en: A Misunderstanding: Runtaixin Says the 5th‑Floor Unit at Songtao Garden Actually Sold at NT$2.54 million per Ping, Higher Than the Previous Deal
paras: 原依實價登錄資料顯示，豪宅「松濤苑」今年6月以總價4億6180萬元無貸款交易，成交原潤泰新(9945-TW)的5樓戶，連6個車位共258.22坪，換算單價244.33萬元，但潤泰新指出，此一登錄資料因作業疏失，這筆松濤苑實價登錄漏列車位價1820萬元，因此實際成交價爲4.8億元，坪價爲254萬元且優於上筆交易的250萬元。
潤泰新並強調，目前潤泰新地政部門預計於27日將就此一交易的實價登錄資料實價向地政局申請資料更正。
潤泰新指出， 「松濤苑」5樓戶，由客戶向潤泰新買下，連同6個車位共達258.22坪，扣除車位後的實際銷售每坪單價為254萬元，比前一次成交還高。
如潤泰新對「松濤苑」5樓戶交易實價登錄交易申報完成更正，豪宅社區「松濤苑」完工13年以來的最新成交價格站穩250萬元之上。
台北市中正區植物園景觀豪宅「松濤苑」只興建12樓，總戶數僅20 戶，目前屋齡13年多，依實價登錄交易14筆的資料顯示， 2015年8月，「松濤苑」6樓戶曾創下每坪270.6萬元的社區每坪最高成交單價。
paras_en: According to the original real‑price registration data, the luxury residence "Songtao Garden" was reported to have been sold in June of this year for a total price of NT$461.8 million without a loan, involving Runtaixin's (9945‑TW) 5th‑floor unit together with six parking spaces covering a total of 258.22 ping, which would imply a unit price of NT$2.4433 million per ping. Runtaixin, however, pointed out that the registration omitted the value of the parking spaces—NT$18.2 million—due to a clerical error, so the actual transaction price was NT$480 million, yielding a per‑ping price of NT$2.54 million, which is higher than the previous transaction price of NT$2.5 million.
Runtaixin emphasized that its land‑administration department plans to submit a request to the Land Administration Bureau on the 27th to correct the real‑price registration data for this transaction.

Runtaixin explained that the 5th‑floor unit at "Songtao Garden" was purchased by a client from Runtaixin, including six parking spaces for a total of 258.22 ping; after excluding the parking spaces, the actual sale price per ping is NT$2.54 million, which is higher than the previous deal.

If Runtaixin completes the correction of the real‑price registration for the 5th‑floor unit transaction, the latest sale price of the "Songtao Garden" luxury community—now 13 years since completion—will remain above NT$2.5 million per ping.

The "Songtao Garden" luxury residence in Taipei's Zhongzheng District, adjacent to the Botanical Garden, consists of only 12 floors and 20 units in total. The building is a little over 13 years old, and according to 14 recorded transactions, the highest per‑ping price in the community was set in August 2015 when a 6th‑floor unit sold for NT$2.706 million per ping.

items.title_en: U.S. Midterm Election Looms as Taiwan Market Accelerates Bottom‑Finding; Six Semiconductor‑Focused ETFs Among the Hottest Picks

Wealth‑management experts note that semiconductor stocks have been strong this year, with many heavyweight names delivering robust performance since the start of the year, leading the market’s bullish trend and lifting semiconductor‑ETF returns along with it.

In terms of scale, the sole active entrant, Uni‑Taiwan Growth ETF (00981A‑TW), grew its assets by 1,231.56% over the past year, outpacing all other passive Taiwan ETFs and standing out uniquely. The other semiconductor ETFs—Yuanta 00927, Taishin 00947, CTBC 00891 and Taishin 00904—also posted asset increases ranging roughly from one‑ to five‑fold.

Looking ahead to 2027, they expect Taiwanese semiconductor firms to maintain a solid competitive moat thanks to advanced process technology, a mature supply‑chain ecosystem and deep long‑term customer relationships, keeping Taiwan at the core of the global semiconductor supply chain in the near term.

He advises investors to take advantage of the current market volatility by gradually building positions in Taiwan semiconductor‑industry ETFs or ETFs focused on AI‑driven IC design and memory sectors, to capture the new tech‑stock rally sparked by global AI dividends and market diffusion.

items.title: 馬斯克稱SpaceX敲定400億美元債務協議！用於採購輝達AI晶片
items.title_en: Musk Says SpaceX Secured $40 Billion Debt Deal for Nvidia AI Chip Purchases
paras: 馬斯克表示，SpaceX(SPCX-US) 已完成一筆規模達400億美元的債務融資交易，用於支付推動其人工智慧（AI）發展計畫所需的晶片費用。
根據《彭博》報導，馬斯克在社群平台X發文討論這項表外融資安排時指出，SpaceX已敲定這筆債務融資，用於採購輝達(NVDA-US) 的圖形處理器（GPU）。
他表示，SpaceX之所以能取得這筆融資，歸功於公司的投資級信用評等，以及星鏈（Starlink）衛星業務和火箭發射業務帶來的營收。
然而，知情人士表示，截至週日（25日），相關各方仍在協商最終定價，這筆交易尚未完成。
馬斯克提及SpaceX多元化的業務布局，藉此將公司與所謂的「新型雲端業者」（neocloud）做區分。這類業者主要向科技公司提供高階運算能力。過去兩週，由於這些公司的借貸規模龐大，且市場對其未來需求前景存疑，因此受到密切關注。
馬斯克在貼文中表示：「過去幾週以來，債務市場幾乎已全面切斷對那些無法從AI資料中心以外的業務取得可觀營收的企業提供資金。」
他指出：「200多家新型雲端業者將面臨如小魚般大量死亡的淘汰潮與整併。最終能存活下來的寥寥無幾。」
他隨後表示，SpaceX不會收購任何新型雲端業者，並稱這麼做「毫無意義」。
隨著市場對AI基礎設施投資熱潮的疑慮升高，SpaceX也未能完全置身事外。根據《彭博》上週五（23日）報導，近期新型雲端業者市場動盪，波及SpaceX規模400億美元的晶片融資計畫，相關各方仍在協商這項表外融資架構的最終定價。
知情人士透露，這項融資安排由高盛集團(GS-US) 等銀行主導，並與由阿波羅全球管理（Apollo Global Management）領軍的投資人洽談。獲阿波羅支持的Atlas SP預計將負責管理相關融資實體。據悉，太平洋投資管理公司（PIMCO）也曾考慮參與投資。
這筆債務預計將透過144A私募方式發行。透過這項最新的融資架構，SpaceX將可避免重演馬斯克旗下AI新創公司xAI去年融資時的情況。當時，一家融資實體試圖透過與Valor Equity Partners簽訂售後租回協議，籌集最高200億美元的表外債務。
然而，根據SpaceX最新財報，該交易最終被認定為「無效的售後租回安排」，導致SpaceX仍須將約130億美元債務列入帳目。
這筆債務融資計畫是在SpaceX第三季業績強勁、旗下AI部門首度實現獲利後提出的。SpaceX正逐漸透過旗下位於孟菲斯的資料中心，向外部AI實驗室及超大規模雲端服務商出售運算能力，藉此帶動營收成長。
在SpaceX的財報電話會議上，財務長Bret Johnsen透露，公司正與貸款機構洽談進一步借款事宜。
他表示：「我們非常有信心，能夠以審慎、有節制的方式推動這項計畫，並在整個過程中持續維持投資級信用評等。」
（本文不開放合作夥伴轉載）
paras_en: Musk said SpaceX (SPCX-US) has completed a $40 billion debt financing transaction to cover the chip costs needed for its artificial intelligence (AI) development program.

According to Bloomberg, Musk posted on X about this off‑balance‑sheet financing arrangement, noting that SpaceX has locked in the debt financing to purchase graphics processing units (GPUs) from Nvidia (NVDA-US).
He said SpaceX was able to obtain the financing thanks to the company’s investment‑grade credit rating and the revenue generated by its Starlink satellite business and rocket launch operations.
However, sources familiar with the matter said that as of Sunday (the 25th), the parties were still negotiating the final pricing and the deal had not yet been completed.

Musk highlighted SpaceX’s diversified business layout to distinguish the company from so‑called “neocloud” providers, which mainly offer high‑performance computing power to tech firms. Over the past two weeks these providers have been under close scrutiny due to their large borrowing needs and uncertain future demand outlooks.
In his post, Musk wrote: “In recent weeks the debt market has virtually cut off funding to companies that cannot generate substantial revenue from businesses beyond AI data centers.”
He added: “More than 200 neocloud providers will face a wave of eliminations and consolidations akin to a school of small fish dying off. Only a few will survive.”
He later said SpaceX will not acquire any neocloud providers, calling such a move “meaningless.”

As doubts grow about the AI infrastructure investment boom, SpaceX is not entirely insulated. Bloomberg reported last Friday (the 23rd) that turbulence in the neocloud market has affected SpaceX’s $40 billion chip financing plan, with parties still negotiating the final pricing of the off‑balance‑sheet structure.

Sources said the financing arrangement is being led by banks such as Goldman Sachs (GS‑US) and is being discussed with investors led by Apollo Global Management. An Atlas SP backed by Apollo is expected to manage the financing entity, and Pacific Investment Management Company (PIMCO) has also been reported to consider participation.

The debt is expected to be issued privately under Rule 144A. Through this new financing structure, SpaceX can avoid repeating the situation that occurred last year when Musk’s AI startup xAI tried to raise up to $20 billion of off‑balance‑sheet debt via a sale‑and‑leaseback agreement with Valor Equity Partners.
However, SpaceX’s latest financial report said that the transaction was ultimately deemed an “invalid sale‑and‑leaseback arrangement,” leaving about $13 billion of debt still on the books.

The financing plan was proposed after SpaceX posted strong third‑quarter results and its AI division posted its first profit. SpaceX is increasingly selling compute capacity from its Memphis data center to external AI labs and hyperscale cloud providers to drive revenue growth.
During the earnings call, CFO Bret Johnsen disclosed that the company is in talks with lenders about additional borrowing.
He said, “We are very confident we can advance this plan in a prudent, disciplined manner while maintaining our investment‑grade credit rating throughout.”
